Vendor profile

Hexagon

Hexagon AB (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) — Global Powerhouse in Industrial Metrology, Intergraph Plant Engineering (CADWorx/CAESAR II) & MSC CAE

By GstarCAD Academy Engineering Editorial Board (Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.) Reviewed by Zhang Mingyuan, B.Eng. (Distinguished DWG Graphics Kernel & GRX SDK Architect) Last reviewed 2026-10-26 Editorial Process & Testbed

1. Strategic Roll-Up of Leica Geosystems, Intergraph (PPM) & MSC Software

Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, Hexagon AB (HEXA B) transformed from an industrial conglomerate into a global engineering reality-capture and software titan through landmark acquisitions: Brown & Sharpe (2000) and Leica Geosystems (2005) for laser trackers, CMMs, and terrestrial LiDAR; Intergraph Corporation ($2.1B in 2010, now Hexagon Asset Lifecycle Intelligence) for process plant design (Smart 3D, CADWorx, CAESAR II); Vero Software (2014, Edgecam/WorkNC); and MSC Software ($834M in 2017, MSC Nastran/Adams).

2. Process Piping Stress (CAESAR II), Isogen PCF & Laser Scan Point Clouds

  • Intergraph Isogen & PCF Standard: Hexagon owns the industry-standard Isogen engine and Piping Component File (`.pcf`) specification used globally to generate automated fabrication isometric drawings from 3D plant models.
  • Leica Cyclone & JetStream Point Cloud Pipeline: Processes billions of LiDAR coordinate returns into `.e57` and `.lgs` reality capture archives for brownfield plant retrofits.

3. Running Plant Piping & Leica Point Cloud Workflows in GstarCAD 2027

EPC piping contractors and industrial surveyors export Leica `.e57`/`.las` scans directly into GstarCAD Point Cloud to model as-built pipe racks, while using GstarCAD 2027 Professional to batch-edit Isogen DWG piping isometrics and CAESAR II support location plans without costly legacy CAD subscriptions.

5. Enterprise Co-Existence, Migration & TCO Optimization Protocol

In production supply chains where upstream 3D models or BIM containers originate from Hexagon AB (Stockholm, Sweden — Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) platforms, engineering IT directors optimize total cost of ownership (TCO) by deploying a tiered seat architecture centered on GstarCAD 2027 and DWG FastView:

  • Verified Data Exchange Pipeline: Stream Leica Geosystems terrestrial laser scans (.e57/.las) into GstarCAD Point Cloud for 2D/3D as-built reconstruction, and batch-process Intergraph Isogen PCF isometric DWG sheets in GstarCAD 2027.
  • Eliminating Redundant Seat Rentals: Rather than purchasing high-cost authoring subscriptions for project managers, site engineers, estimators, CNC operators, and quality inspectors who primarily review geometry or annotate 2D DWG/DXF sheets, organizations equip 70%–80% of their workforce with GstarCAD Perpetual Floating Licenses (GstarLM) and FastView 3D.
  • Automated Database Hygiene Before Transmittal: Prior to archiving project deliverables or importing external vendor DWG exports into corporate PDM/CDE vaults, run GstarCAD's batch script sequence (-PURGE RegApps → OVERKILL → AUDIT Yes → INDEXCTL = 3) to guarantee sub-second opening times and zero proxy object corruption.
